title: Message Center Watch — Copilot Cost & Cowork
blurb: A filtered, plain-language digest of Microsoft 365 Message center posts that touch Copilot Cowork, Copilot Credits, usage-based billing and Cost management — the official admin change notices behind the FinOps surface. Built from the public, MIT-licensed merill/mc Message Center Archive; each item links to its Message center post. Message center content varies by tenant — always use your own tenant's Message center as the source of truth.
